Hi Elena — thanks for the clear summary and for sending the form. Short answer: we recommend the portal where possible, but we support an email fallback with strict conventions to keep PO matching reliable. Below is a concise checklist and the fields we require for both paths.

Portal (preferred)
- Single sign-on onboarding; portal will carry entity mapping (you can upload invoices and tag remit-to).
- Recommended for high-volume and multi-entity flows — supports currency and VAT per-entity.
- No subject token needed; we link invoices to POs via PO number and entity mapping in the portal.

Email fallback (allowed)
- Subject token format: Redwood-Invoice|ENTITY=<ENTITY_CODE>|PO=<PO_NUMBER>  (example: Redwood-Invoice|ENTITY=MH-EU|PO=PO-45812)
- Filename convention: invoice-<ENTITY_CODE>-<invoice_number>.pdf (example: invoice-MH-EU-2027-0042.pdf)
- Required invoice fields for PO match: PO number, invoice date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD), invoice total, line-item descriptions, unit price, quantity, remit-to entity code.
- For multi-entity POs we require the entity code to appear on the invoice header AND in the subject token.

VAT & currency
- If billing the EU legal entity, include VAT registration number on the invoice header and send amounts in EUR. Our portal supports VAT validation; email invoices will be validated at ingest and may be rejected if VAT fields are missing.

Next steps from MacroHealth
1) Confirm the internal ENTITY_CODE mapping you want us to use (two-letter short codes are fine).
2) Send a test invoice for each entity using the subject token and filename convention above. We will validate and respond with a pass/fail report.
3) If you prefer the portal, ask your portal admin for an invite link and we will provision accounts for both entities.

Attaching a sample CSV we use for automated ingest (columns listed inline). If you want, Vanessa will follow up with the subject-token regex and any per-tenant limits.

Hi — quick technical notes to make the test smooth: 

1) Mixed-entity single-PDF handling
- Our current ingest pipeline prefers one legal-entity per invoice PDF for automated posting. If you include split lines for multiple entities in one PDF we will accept it but it will trigger manual review / slower processing. For full automation, please submit separate invoices per entity.

2) VAT handling
- For EU-billed POs: provide VAT number and tax breakdown per line (net, tax amount, gross). If you want Redwood to mark as reverse-charge on receipt, include a header note "REVERSE CHARGE" and we will set the accounting tag, but please confirm this on the portal onboarding form.

3) Subject token regex and parser limits
- Regex (example): ^Redwood-Invoice\|ENTITY=(MH-[A-Z]{2})\|PO=([A-Za-z0-9\-]+)$
- Max filename length: 120 chars. Max attachments per email: 5. Max email size: 25MB.

4) Sample CSV columns (if you send CSV instead of PDF):
- invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), entity_code, po_number, line_number, item_description, quantity, unit_price, line_total, currency, vat_amount

5) Test process and timeline
- Please send two test invoices (one per entity) using the subject token and filename convention today. We will validate within 24 business hours and send a validation report.

6) Onboarding form & DocuSign
- We received your PDF form. Marissa will issue a DocuSign for signature that includes the remit-to mapping for each entity. Signing that document finalizes the entity codes in our portal. HubSpot deal: HS-983412.

If you want, we can provision portal accounts now and you can upload a bulk CSV to the staging area; that will avoid manual review. Let me know which approach you prefer.

Best,
